name: Nora Leonard
original_name: โนร่า ลีโอนาร์ท
source:
Etymology: Nora = Shining Light | Leonard = Brave as a Lion
Age: 42
Nationality: Rosetanian
Role: Florist
Personality: A gentle single mother who has raised her son with love and without pressure. Though kind and calm, she is firm when it comes to her child's well-being. She loves peace, helping others, and speaks with a sweet, polite grace that reflects her love for flowers.

[From in-game profile]
